for note_id, title in [(n['note_id'], n['title']) for n in all_habit_notes]:
    note = apis.simple_note.show_note(access_token=access_token, note_id=note_id)
    # Extract date from title: "Habit Tracking Log for YYYY-MM-DD"
    date_str = note['title'].replace('Habit Tracking Log for ', '')
    # Parse content lines after the header
    lines = note['content'].split('\n')
    # Find the line with habits (after the header line)
    habits = {}
    for line in lines:

            habits[key.strip()] = val.strip()

# Fetch content for all habit notes and parse
import re
from datetime import datetime

habit_data = []
for note_meta in all_habit_notes:
    note = apis.simple_note.show_note(access_token=access_token, note_id=note_meta['note_id'])
    content = note['content']
    # Extract date from title
    date_str = note['title'].replace('Habit Tracking Log for ', '')
    # Parse habits from content lines
    habits = {}
    for line in content.split('\n'):
        if ':' in line:
            key, val = line.split(':', 1)
            habits[key.strip()] = val.strip()
    habit_data.append({'date': date_str, 'habits': habits})

# Sort by date ascending
habit_data.sort(key=lambda x: datetime.strptime(x['date'], '%Y-%m-%d'))

# Get habit order from first note (they should be same order)
habit_order = list(habit_data[0]['habits'].keys())
print(habit_order)
print(len(habit_data))
